lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows along the mid-flank. The centroids exhibit a non-uniform grid-like distribution with increasing inter-spot distance observed from the anterior to the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, creating anchor nodes where they intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, most evident in the central lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-contrast white vertical mark is visible on the upper mid-flank, posterior to the branchial region, which deviates from the circular morphology of natural spots.
other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae individuals are visible swimming adjacent to the ventral margin of the animal's flank.
